validity.recommendation: Correct EndState/Province from 'Makkah' to 'Eastern Province' (Ash Sharqiyah); verify start location (Khuff/Haradh field).
validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE: Confirmed real. The Khuff non-associated gas transmission system feeding the south-Ghawar gas complex is well documented by multiple independent sources. Offshore-technology.com's Haradh project profile states verbatim: 'The gas is carried to the plant by five 20in and 30in gas transmission lines that total 130km' (distinct from the 680km of wellhead gathering lines), and that Khuff gas 'comes only from the Haradh field.' Saudipedia and the OGJ 'Saudi gas utilization' feature independently confirm the Khuff/Jauf non-associated sour-gas system in this area. So a 30-in, ~43km Khuff gas transmission line in this corridor is physically real and consistent with the documented infrastructure.

CLASSIFICATION: Correct as recorded. This is dry/sour NON-ASSOCIATED gas (Khuff reservoir) transmission, not NGL or oil and not a gathering line. Offshore-technology explicitly labels these the plant's 'gas transmission lines' (separate from the 680km gathering network). Fuel=Gas confirmed.

DUPLICATE: Not a duplicate of a different-named pipe, but note GEM has split one documented aggregate into three sister entries. P1917, P1918 (Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah 2), and P1919 (Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah 3) are each 43km x 30in; 3 x 43 = 129km, matching the independently documented 'five 20in and 30in gas transmission lines that total 130km' almost exactly (the 20-in member is likely P1920 Tinat Kuff-Haradh). The three parallel 30-in lines are plausible real parallel laterals, so no merge is recommended, but the per-line 43km/30in figures are GEM's own segmentation of the 130km aggregate, not an independently published per-line spec.

ATTRIBUTION (the concern): GEM records EndState/Province = 'Makkah'. This is WRONG. Both endpoints (Haradh field / Hawiyah Gas Plant) lie in the EASTERN PROVINCE (Ash Sharqiyah), on the southern end of the Ghawar field in/near Al-Ahsa Governorate. Wikipedia's Haradh gas plant article places it 'near Haradh village, 300 km southwest of Dhahran' (Eastern Province); Saudipedia places the Hawiyah Gas Plant in Al-Jubail Industrial City (also Eastern Province). There is no part of this system in Makkah province. Owner Saudi Aramco (100%) is correct and confirmed.

SPEC: Length 43km and diameter 30in are CONSISTENT with the documented 130km/five-line aggregate but are NOT independently confirmed at the per-line level (no source publishes a discrete '43km Khuff-Hawiyah' line); treat as caveat. Capacity unknown and left blank (not fabricated).

fills.researcher_notes: Province correction: both Haradh field and the Hawiyah Gas Plant are in the Eastern Province, not Makkah. Wikipedia (Haradh gas plant, near Haradh village SW of Dhahran) and Saudipedia (Hawiyah Gas Plant, Al-Jubail Industrial City) independently place this in the Eastern Province.
Fuel=Gas confirmed: non-associated sour gas from the Khuff reservoir (offshore-technology Haradh profile; Khuff gas 'comes only from the Haradh field'). Dry/sour gas transmission, not NGL/oil.

30-in diameter consistent with the documented 'five 20in and 30in gas transmission lines that total 130km' feeding the south-Ghawar Khuff gas plant. Source corroborates 30-in as a line size in this system but does not name a discrete 43km Khuff-Hawiyah line, so per-line value is GEM segmentation (caveat).

Length 43km is NOT independently confirmed at the per-line level. It is consistent with the aggregate (three sister 30-in lines x 43km = 129km ~ the documented 130km five-line system), but no source publishes a discrete 43km Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah line. Leaving as UNRESOLVED/caveat rather than asserting a hard corroboration.
Owner Saudi Aramco (100%) confirmed: the entire Haradh/Hawiyah south-Ghawar Khuff gas system is owned and operated by Saudi Aramco (offshore-technology Haradh profile; Wikipedia Haradh gas plant).

summary: P1917 Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah gas pipeline: real & correctly classed as Khuff non-associated gas transmission, Aramco-owned; CONCERN(attribution) - province is wrongly recorded as Makkah, should be Eastern Province; 43km/30in spec only corroborated as part of the documented 130km five-line aggregate (per-line value unverified).
